Class RealPlanetaryEngineBenchmarkRunner

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.benchmark.RealPlanetaryEngineBenchmarkRunner
public class RealPlanetaryEngineBenchmarkRunner extends Object

Real Planetary Simulation Engine Benchmark Runner

Ground-truth, non-extrapolated empirical benchmark runner executing the complete H3SimulationEngine simulation pipeline across 5 distinct scientific axes:

  1. Axis 1 (Spatial Grid Scaling): Full planetary Earth from Res 2 up to Res 7 (Res 2, 3, 4, 5 Global, and Res 6 / Res 7 DOD memory limits).
  2. Axis 2 (Temporal Step Resolution $\Delta t$): Daily (1d), Weekly (7d), Monthly (30d), Annual (365d) with simulated time and wall-clock execution time for 10,000 ticks.
  3. Axis 3 (Compute Backend Architecture): Java JIT Monocœur vs Java 21 SIMD Vector Multicœur vs Native Rust Core (FFI / AVX-512 + Rayon).
  4. Axis 4 (Physics Coupling Tiers): Tier 1 biophysical conservation PDEs only vs Tier 1 + Tier 2 full cliodynamics (SDT, Tainter, World3, Institutions, Trade).
  5. Axis 5 (Historical Epochs & Demographic Scale): Out of Africa (-100k), Neolithic (-10k), Classical Antiquity (-500), Industrial (+1800), Modern (+2026).
